description: Target weights must have unique method-date-ticker keys.
Every portfolio must sum to one.
Portfolio weights must be long-only.
No security may exceed its maximum weight.
No sector may exceed its maximum portfolio weight.
Every portfolio must contain enough active positions.
All target weights must be finite.
Optimized portfolio beta must remain above its lower bound.
Optimized portfolio beta must remain below its upper bound.
No target position may exceed the configured share of Average Dollar Volume.
CVaR estimates must be finite.
CVaR loss must not be below the corresponding VaR loss.
Every optimization must use enough historical scenarios.
CVaR portfolio beta must remain above its lower bound.
CVaR portfolio beta must remain below its upper bound.
CVaR positions must respect the configured liquidity limit.
Median-MAD objective values must be finite.
Median return estimates must be finite.
MAD estimates must be finite.
Every optimization must use enough historical observations.
Median-MAD portfolios must remain fully invested.
Median-MAD positions must respect the security weight limit.
Median-MAD sector weights must respect the sector limit.
Median-MAD portfolio beta must remain above its lower bound.
Median-MAD portfolio beta must remain below its upper bound.
Median-MAD positions must respect the liquidity limit.
Median-MAD turnover must be non-negative.
